title: 紅葉と銀杏のフレーム
subject_en: Decorative frames/borders with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, landscape or square, thick enough to hold text or a photo, decorated with the motifs of the theme. Japanese traditional (wa) style, maple leaves and ginkgo leaves in red, orange and gold. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 紅葉と銀杏の葉で縁取った、12点の飾り枠です。秋の案内状、おたより、写真の額に使えます。
